title: Web Server Technology
mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are the routines that manage access to the various disk- based data structures that the system supports."
Access methods are the routines that manage access to the various disk- based data structures that the system supports.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an acronym for Active Server Pages."
ASP is an acronym for Active Server Pages.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the software that delivers web pages to the world."
The web server is the software that delivers web pages to the world.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are used to declare entities existing only in the DTD."
Internal parameter entity references are used to declare entities existing only in the DTD.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is used by the query processor during authentication, parsing, and query optimisation."
The catalogue is used by the query processor during authentication, parsing, and query optimisation.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an extension to basic HTML that allows you to style your web pages."
CSS is an extension to basic HTML that allows you to style your web pages.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the grey bar along the bottom of a web browser where information like, how much the page has loaded and the URL which a link is pointing to appears."
The status bar is the grey bar along the bottom of a web browser where information like, how much the page has loaded and the URL which a link is pointing to appears.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a style sheet language used for describing the presentation semantics (the look and formatting) of a document written in a markup language."
Cascading Style Sheets (CSS) is a style sheet language used for describing the presentation semantics (the look and formatting) of a document written in a markup language.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a markup language much like HTML, created to structure, store, and transport information."
XML is a markup language much like HTML, created to structure, store, and transport information.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is used to collect values in a form with the POST method information sent from a form with the POST method is invisible to others and has no limits on the amount of information to send."
Form command is used to collect values in a form with the POST method information sent from a form with the POST method is invisible to others and has no limits on the amount of information to send.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is any application that is usable only with an active Internet connection and that uses HTTP as its primary communications protocol."
A web-based application is any application that is usable only with an active Internet connection and that uses HTTP as its primary communications protocol.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a completely different programming language."
Java is a completely different programming language.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a piece of code that performs a specific task; it may also be called a subroutine or a method."
A function is a piece of code that performs a specific task; it may also be called a subroutine or a method.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are used to link external DTDs."
External parameter entity references are used to link external DTDs.
fib: ______ is a perfectly suitable tool for writing XHTML.
Notepad
Notepad is a perfectly suitable tool for writing XHTML.
______ is a different way of including JavaScript on your page.
link event
A link event is a different way of including JavaScript on your page.
______ are used by the database administrator to determine the access/usage rights that database users possess.
DCL commands
DCL commands are used by the database administrator to determine the access/usage rights that database users possess.
______ is a special-purpose programming language designed for managing data held in a relational database management system (RDBMS).
SQL (Structured Query Language)
SQL
SQL (Structured Query Language) is a special-purpose programming language designed for managing data held in a relational database management system (RDBMS).
______ are called siblings (brothers or sisters).
Children on the same level
Children on the same level are called siblings (brothers or sisters).
______ are the building blocks of XML, dividing a document into a hierarchy of regions, each serving a specific purpose.
Elements
Elements are the building blocks of XML, dividing a document into a hierarchy of regions, each serving a specific purpose.
______ are used to provide additional information about elements.
Attributes
Attributes are used to provide additional information about elements.
______ are a mechanism by which element and attribute names can be assigned to groups.
Namespaces
Namespaces are a mechanism by which element and attribute names can be assigned to groups.
______ is a web standard which has been agreed by the W3C and, as it is backwards compatible, you can start using it in your web pages now.
XHTML
XHTML is a web standard which has been agreed by the W3C and, as it is backwards compatible, you can start using it in your web pages now.
______ is an embedded scripting language when used in web pages.
PHP
PHP is an embedded scripting language when used in web pages.
______ is a scripting language produced by netscape for use within HTML web pages.
JavaScript
JavaScript is a scripting language produced by netscape for use within HTML web pages.
______ are a very useful part of functions.
Parameters
Parameters are a very useful part of functions.
______ is used for output in PHP similar.
echo statement
The echo statement is used for output in PHP similar.
